## JustMic 1.5.0 — A new kind of studio

- **Rebuilt Canvas and Midnight:** entirely new app shells with focused effect editors, searchable navigation and a dedicated sound library. Classic Rack keeps its familiar all-at-once layout.
- **Controls with room to breathe:** full-width parameter rows retain click-to-type values, range checks, fine adjustment and reset gestures. Presets and session controls stay accessible.
- **See and find your sound:** larger live analysis, clearer switches and responsive sound cards. Search for an effect to jump straight to it.
- **Your setup stays yours:** audio processing, routing, monitoring, presets, soundboard playback and recording are unchanged. Choose a layout in **Settings → Appearance**, then restart when ready; dark/light colors remain independent.

Updates preserve your settings and sound library and do not repeat driver setup. Finish calls and recordings before restarting. HEAR ME can still be captured by screen-sharing or recording software; use PAUSE FOR SHARING when needed.
